entries.name: GitHub
entries.summary: Repositories, issues, pull requests and code search on GitHub, from GitHub's own server.
entries.token_help: Paste a personal access token (github.com/settings/personal-access-tokens). Give it only the repositories and permissions you want runs to have.
entries.notes: GitHub's sign-in does not register clients by itself, so a token is the simplest way. For finer control over what a run may do on a repository, use ZORIX's own GitHub connection.

entries.name: Linear
entries.summary: Issues, projects and cycles in Linear.

entries.name: Notion
entries.summary: Search and read pages and databases in your Notion workspace.

entries.name: Atlassian
entries.summary: Jira and Confluence: issues, pages and search.
entries.notes: This is the current endpoint; the older /v1/mcp one is being retired.

entries.name: Sentry
entries.summary: Errors, issues and traces from Sentry.

entries.name: Figma
entries.summary: Read designs and components from Figma files.

entries.name: DeepWiki
entries.summary: Documentation and answers about public GitHub repositories. Needs no account.
entries.notes: Public and read-only. Questions you ask are sent to DeepWiki.

entries.name: Cloudflare Docs
entries.summary: Search Cloudflare's documentation. Needs no account.
entries.notes: Public and read-only. Questions you ask are sent to Cloudflare.

entries.name: Filesystem
entries.summary: Read and write files in a folder you choose, through the reference server.
entries.notes: It runs as you. ZORIX's own workspace tools are confined to one folder per run and ask before writing; this server decides for itself.

entries.name: Fetch
entries.summary: Fetch a web page and turn it into text, through the reference server.
entries.notes: It can reach any address your computer can, including private ones. ZORIX's own web tool refuses those.

entries.name: Playwright
entries.summary: Drive a real browser: open pages, click, read what is there.
entries.notes: A browser can sign in as you wherever you are signed in. Run it only for tasks that need it.

entries.name: Neon
entries.summary: Postgres projects, branches and SQL on Neon, from Neon's own server.
entries.notes: It can change your databases. Tools that change something ask first, whatever the server says about them.

entries.name: Supabase
entries.summary: Projects, tables, SQL and logs on Supabase.
entries.notes: Sign in with a project in mind: the server can reach what that account can.

entries.name: Vercel
entries.summary: Projects, deployments and logs on Vercel.

entries.name: Asana
entries.summary: Tasks, projects and comments in Asana.

entries.name: Stripe
entries.summary: Customers, payments and docs on Stripe.
entries.token_help: Paste a restricted API key (dashboard.stripe.com/apikeys) that has only the permissions you want runs to have. Start with test mode.
entries.notes: This can move money if the key allows it. Use a restricted key, and test mode first.

entries.name: Hugging Face
entries.summary: Search models, datasets, Spaces and papers on the Hub.

entries.name: Context7
entries.summary: Up-to-date documentation and code examples for libraries.

entries.name: Memory
entries.summary: A small knowledge graph a model can write to and read, kept in a file by the reference server.
entries.notes: This is the server's own memory, separate from ZORIX's, which a person approves entry by entry.

entries.name: Sequential thinking
entries.summary: A scratchpad for working through a problem in steps, through the reference server.
entries.notes: Meant to need no files and no network; like any local server it runs as you.

entries.name: Git
entries.summary: Status, diffs, logs and commits of one repository, through the reference server.
entries.notes: It can commit in that repository, and like any local server it runs as you.

entries.name: Time
entries.summary: The current time in any time zone and conversions between them, through the reference server.
entries.notes: Meant to need no files and no network; like any local server it runs as you.
